OBB Oberbadische Bettfedernfabrik GmbH is a renowned German manufacturer of high-quality bedding, specializing in down duvets, pillows, and mattress toppers. Headquartered in Lörrach, Germany, at the crossroads of Germany, Switzerland, and France, OBB has been crafting premium sleep products for nearly 120 years. For more than 70 years, the company has operated from the pristine natural surroundings of the Southern Black Forest, a region long associated with precision, craftsmanship, and quality. OBB is one of the few remaining fully integrated down and feather manufacturers in Germany, overseeing every step of the production process in-house. Their state-of-the-art facility spans 170,000 square feet and is equipped with modern machinery that allows for complete control, traceability, and quality assurance—from incoming material inspection to the final stitch of each finished duvet or pillow. At the heart of production is OBB’s in-house laboratory, certified by the European Down and Feather Association (EDFA), where fabrics and fillings are continuously tested to ensure compliance with the highest European quality standards. The company’s long-standing success is built on skilled craftsmanship, decades of expertise in down and feather processing, carefully selected raw materials, and an uncompromising commitment to innovation, sustainability, and superior sleep comfort.
